Central during normal business hours.  In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500.
